name: Fruit Party

features.name: Random multipliers
features.description: Any winning symbol can randomly turn into a 2x multiplier; multipliers on the same cluster are combined.

features.name: Free spins
features.description: 3+ scatters award 10+ free spins with more frequent multipliers.

review: Fruit Party is an earlier Pragmatic cluster game and in many ways the prototype for Sugar Rush. Random 2x multipliers attach to winning symbols and stack when several land in the same cluster. It's simpler and less dramatic than its successor, but the frequent small cluster wins make it a good choice if you want a fruit slot that still has a proper bonus.
cons: Feels dated next to Sugar Rush
Multiplier wins are hard to predict
author: editorial-team
